authorities.startup: exact configured authorities and qualified pinned head only

cursor.initial_boundary: explicit install-time outbox coordinate; events at or before it are never auto-projected
cursor.advance: after durable handoff or durable held disposition

reader.sql: canonical_membership_outbox WHERE outbox_id > cursor ORDER BY outbox_id ASC LIMIT bounded_batch

crash_semantics: projection, Opening and handoff identity are durable; a crash before cursor advance may replay an outbox event and destination identity is deterministic
